rationale: The prompt's central requirement is logged-in dashboard screenshot and DOM/state capture without interaction or source debugging. The anchored # In-App Events scopes the source-visible material to When the user wants to create, plan, or optimize App Store In-App Events — the event cards that appear on the Today tab, search results, and your product page. Use when the user mentions "in-app event", "App Store event", which does not provide a plausible route to that central input/output boundary.
